name: SUN RGB-D: A RGB-D Scene Understanding Benchmark Suite
description: SUN RGB-D is a landmark 3D indoor scene understanding dataset containing 10,335 RGB-D images annotated with 64,595 3D oriented bounding boxes across 800 object categories. Published at CVPR 2015 by Princeton University, it aggregates aligned color and depth frames captured with four different sensor types to benchmark 3D object detection, semantic scene parsing, and room layout estimation.
